messages:
alyssa: Quick sync — AcmeRetail POC kickoff. They've hit an issue: when streaming with our Node SDK + function-calls, callback events intermittently drop and the client falls back to poll flow. Need a short mitigation plan before tomorrow's demo.

samir: Can you paste a minimal repro and SDK version + region?

alyssa: SDK v0.9.2, region us-west-2. Using SSE stream via /v1/streams with structured JSON output and function/tool calls to their payment service. Symptoms: occasional 502 from our edge, client reconnects, and tool-call events aren't replayed. Small snippet of their client handshake:

```js
const s = new StreamClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const stream = await s.open('/v1/streams', { model: 'redwood-2', streaming: true })
stream.on('data', d => handleChunk(d))
```

dmitri: 502+reconnect pattern usually points at an intermediary (edge proxy) closing idle chunked connections. Are they using a proxy that buffers/chunks or a TLS terminator with short timeouts?

alyssa: Yes — they run an Nginx reverse proxy at the edge that terminates TLS and forwards to our backend. They said defaults are in place.

eva-eng: Two quick mitigations we can recommend: 1) enable SSE keepalive (send a small comment/event every 25–30s) — on the SDK this is header x-keepalive: 30s or enableKeepalive(true). 2) Opt into our experimental "preserve-tool-calls" flag on the request body so the runtime buffers tool events across reconnects and replays them when the client resumes. I can PR the SDK change for (1) and flip the feature flag for the POC.

samir: Also advise them to set idempotency keys for tool calls so duplicates are safe if we replay. For structured output parsing, recommend schemaStrict:false during POC to reduce brittle failures while we tune the model.

alyssa: They also asked about ephemeral credentials for their on‑prem connector — legal wants rotation docs and TTL options. Who owns the short‑lived creds sample?

dmitri: Use our ephemeral token endpoint: POST /v1/sessions -> { token, expires_in }. Example curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions -H 'Authorization: Bearer <MASTER>' -d '{"aud":"onprem-proxy","ttl":3600}'
```

Explain rotation: fetch token on app start and refresh with backoff at 75% TTL. For Dedicated customers we can also provide SAML-backed short-lived certs if they need mTLS.

alyssa: Pricing question: they want to estimate cost for a 100 QPS chat with streaming and tool calls — should we suggest per‑token or per‑session for the POC?

samir: For POC recommend per‑token billing; for committed Dedicated deployments we can offer a blended rate with QPS reservation. I'll loop in sales for a short credits bucket for the demo.

integrations-bot: Opened issue #482 for SDK keepalive + preserve-tool-calls docs: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/issues/482 :memo:

alyssa: Can we get a short runbook before the call tomorrow? Checklist: 1) check proxy timeouts (Nginx keepalive_timeout & proxy_read_timeout), 2) enable SDK keepalive, 3) set idempotency keys on tool calls, 4) enable preserve-tool-calls for the runtime, 5) ephemeral creds sample + rotation notes, 6) pricing note for POC credit.

eva-eng: I'll draft the runbook in the repo and paste a link by 08:30 PST. Will include Nginx snippets and minimal curl samples.

samir: I'll join the customer call at 09:30 PST to walk through the mitigation steps.

alyssa: Awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
